facts.fact: 冰戏：她闭眼、那么信任——因为在他身边觉得安全
facts.anchor: She was gorgeous—eyes closed, so trusting. I knew it was because she felt safe with me, and that was a heady feeling.

facts.fact: 看她在自己手里崩解：信任是他最大的快感
facts.anchor: Seeing her unravel, knowing she trusted me.

facts.fact: 心里话：她是我的，不会让她忘
facts.anchor: She was mine, and I wouldn’t let her forget it.

facts.fact: 吻里的承诺：记住她的需要并放第一位，哪怕说了hockey first
facts.anchor: A promise that I would remember her needs and put them first, even if we’d said that hockey came first.

facts.fact: 她让他停手：先问检测——无套前的责任谈判
facts.anchor: “When was the last time you were tested?”

facts.fact: 他坦白：赛季初检测过；遇见她之前已空窗很久
facts.anchor: “Beginning of the season. Before you, I hadn’t been with anyone—” I glanced down and away “—in a while.

facts.fact: 空窗期十八个月——他自嘲的诚意
她同样赛季初检测；此后只有他
facts.anchor: my results were clear. You’re the only person I’ve been with since then.

facts.fact: 她的授权：有IUD，我信任你——避孕责任与信任一起递交
facts.anchor: But if you don’t, I have an IUD, and I trust you.

facts.fact: 无套不只是身体：身心都更亲密
录像回放抓到伏笔：Atlas盯着Georgia与Daniel拥抱、咬紧下颌
facts.anchor: Georgia hugging her brother while Atlas watched on with a clenched jaw.
“Oh shit. I wonder if Atlas is Georgia’s mystery man.”
“If it was Atlas, that would be…messy.”

facts.fact: Cup Day传统：他不能带奖杯回家乡——家庭缺席再刺一刀
facts.anchor: Many players took the Cup to their hometowns, which I obviously wouldn’t be doing.

facts.fact: 转会悬念：经纪人称Anaheim与Minnesota都在起草合同，未定前保密
facts.anchor: I was still waiting to hear back from my agent

facts.fact: 她决定：先告诉Levi再告诉别人
facts.anchor: I owed him that much at least.

facts.fact: Frasier/Bryn相吻，她别开眼：像个闯入者
facts.anchor: It was such a simple moment, natural and beautiful, and I glanced away, feeling like an intruder.

facts.fact: 章末反转：不是闯入者，是骗子
